name: Armored Land Cruisers
headline: ARMORED LAND CRUISER
lede: Premium armored Land Cruisers designed for ultimate protection & reliability.
about: Besides the armored vehicles or armored cars and trucks, the company can also help you get the security cabins according to your desired specifications which can be armoured to level B6 and fitted with gun-ports. These security guard cabins can be very useful for security guards and check point operators who can do their duties without being exposed to dangers.

The high quality bullet proof cars are designed with clinical accuracy and precision. All four sides of the passenger compartment and the roof of the vehicle are protected using high quality armor steel and glass defeating 7.62 x 51mm M80 NATO ball ammunition (US NIJ Level III, CEN Level B6) and 5.56 x 45 SS109 ammunition (CEN Level B5 and B6) at 0Â° incidence (90Â° to the surface) and 10 m range according to CEN...
